minimal_correct_design: Keep physical lot choice/provenance and existing atomic lock/permission/idempotency framework. FIFO may select physical pieces, never their transfer price. Any active target remains selectable; reciprocal pair is convenience.

One server quote under the existing envelope for exact product_id + selected location_id + GRADE_A: all owned physical positions, including reserved pieces; Q=physical, R=reserved, A=Q-R, V=actual effective current value, average=V/Q. Sum the full scope before pagination/search. Unknown relevant cost is not zero or excluded. Empty target is explicitly EMPTY, not fabricated zero average. Recheck quote/version after lock before any effects.

For a new conversion q<=available, calculate transfer M from current source V/Q at full precision, round the transaction amount once to cents, then source (Q-q,V-M), target (Qt+q,Vt+M). Manual B-to-A uses a new request/event and the then-current B average; it never invokes REVERSE on A-to-B.

Required missing representation: append-only sourced valuation events/inputs and a rebuildable remaining-position valuation projection keyed by lot/location/grade (or equivalent exact custody slices). Retain physical lineage separately from weighted economic-source lineage. Each event pins source/target before-state, all financial contributors with cost-version IDs and rational weights, physical allocation refs, transferred exact amount, timestamps, and deterministic residuals. This is necessary, not optional UI data.

Let C be cost of physically picked fragments under the old lot view. Average transfer requires explicit source remaining-value adjustment C-M and destination adjustment M-C relative to physical carry-forward; their sum is zero. Example 2@10+2@30, pick one cheap piece: C=10,M=20; remaining old view70 must become60, destination10 must become20. Record this as sourced inventory value redistribution, never unsourced conversion_cost_total, cash, fake purchase, OTHER expense/income, or rewriting old HPP/movements. Per-position residual allocation must stay nonnegative and conserve all source contributions.

One shared effective valuation projection must feed conversion quote/post, location stock/card values and affected HPP/GL/COGS/returns. Existing lot_value(lot,qty) lacks enough location information. Reuse unaffected legacy readers/flows where possible, but subsequent use of affected stock must consume its actual residual value. Do not claim average conversion while ordinary readers still multiply remaining qty by the old lot HPP.

Current PO/nonPO propagation, transfer-recost target, recovery_graph and V2620F_CONVERSION_VALUE_LINEAGE_MISMATCH require a narrowly identified new average-event rule: prove weighted sourced target + legitimate linked extra/recovery, exact physical OUT/IN and aggregate/PO/nonPO value conservation. Retain legacy rule for existing conversions. Do not remove detectors or bypass mismatch checks.

Later HPP corrections append new valuation versions/events and GL DELTAS through recorded economic contributors, including contributors not physically picked. Replay valuation dependencies in event order with the original eligible contributor set/weights; do not include later receipts in an earlier average. Track FG/COGS/other custody disposition and existing physical/economic/recognition dates. Mixed PO/nonPO attribution must follow financial contributors, while original physical PO lineage stays intact. Repeated recost with unchanged source is zero-effect.

Rounding: authoritative group amount M; child amounts by deterministic cumulative apportionment (rounded cumulative ideal minus previously allocated cents), sum exactly M. Store total amounts and explicit residuals, never reconstruct from rounded 6-decimal unit HPP. Full depletion transfers all remaining value. Recost delta = new cumulative target minus prior posted cumulative target. Preserve raw precision separately only with an explicit reconciliation residual; no hidden cent tolerance accumulation.
